skills.title: 商品主视觉
skills.description: 从一张商品图出发，设计一张主体清晰、材质可信的广告创意图。

presentation.descriptionEn: Turn one product reference into a focused advertising image with believable materials.
presentation.inputZh: 一张商品图 + 你的用途
presentation.outputZh: 一张创意图；产品与文字需核对
presentation.outputEn: One creative image; review the product and text

skills.title: 商品动态镜头
skills.description: 让一张商品图成为一段连续镜头，保持主体并安排清楚的运动起止。

presentation.descriptionEn: Make one continuous product shot with a clear camera move and consistent identity.
presentation.inputZh: 一张商品图 + 想表现的动作
presentation.outputZh: 一段连续视频；不含额外剪辑配音
presentation.outputEn: One continuous video; no separate editing or voiceover

skills.title: 商品提示词整理
skills.description: 把零散信息整理成完整、可修改的图片提示词，不直接生成媒体。

presentation.descriptionEn: Shape scattered product facts into a complete editable image prompt, without generating media.
presentation.inputZh: 商品事实或原有提示词；图片可选
presentation.inputEn: Product facts or an existing prompt; image optional
presentation.outputZh: 完整提示词 + 最多三个核对点
presentation.outputEn: A complete prompt + up to three checks
